measurement.reason_execution_not_submitted: The deterministic harness stops when strict-cap simulation fails.

implemented_optimization.description: The real private-transfer 1-to-2 processor reuses the already decoded CanonicalPoolStateV1 for append instead of entering the standalone decode/validate path.

focused_host_gates.coverage: Two-leaf prevalidated transition is byte-for-byte and receipt-for-receipt identical to the standalone checked transition; substituted Pool identity fails before callback.
Verifier failure and account aliasing are atomic; verifier acceptance consumes the marker, appends two ordered leaves, and emits exact ASTR return data.

remaining_static_hotspot.duplicate_pool_decode: authenticate_historical_anchor_v1 independently reloads and reconstructs the depth-20 Pool tree after the processor already produced CanonicalPoolStateV1.
remaining_static_hotspot.duplicate_history_scans: For the normal latest-root case, the same 8,256-byte root page is fully validated three times: historical-anchor authentication, current-history preflight, and append preflight.
remaining_static_hotspot.required_work: The sealed append_two retains both chronological roots and therefore still performs the two required output-root paths; neither may be deleted.

smallest_next_gate: Introduce a private sealed anchor/current-history token constructed from the existing CanonicalPoolStateV1 and one complete root-page validation, then consume that token in append. Prove byte-exact equivalence and fail-closed substitution before any further SBF build.
